name: CropFit v0.10 independent density-shift validation
target: EcoCrop mechanistic screening teacher; not observed yield

protocol.generator: Independently seeded scipy LatinHypercube over the same physical support; not the training generator.
protocol.champion: v0.9.1 reconstructed with 120 fitting scenarios per crop and 70 Extra Trees
protocol.candidate: v0.10 candidate reconstructed with 240 fitting scenarios per crop and 32 Extra Trees
protocol.heldOutPolicy: Production-seed test crop profiles only; candidate selected without this shifted set.
protocol.declaredGate: Against the exact v0.9.1 estimator, all raw and deployed error gains must be >=5% on independently generated Latin-hypercube scenarios; irrigated, rainfed, and active MAE must each improve; active coverage must remain within 2 points of nominal on both frozen-random and shifted tests.

gate.rule: Against the exact v0.9.1 estimator, all raw and deployed error gains must be >=5% on independently generated Latin-hypercube scenarios; irrigated, rainfed, and active MAE must each improve; active coverage must remain within 2 points of nominal on both frozen-random and shifted tests.
